findings.title: The plot plan shows which plots are empty, not the offer to the next person in line

location.description: the title of the plot plan next to the headline (under the button on phone and tablet)

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees a status map with two green plots. The headline and subhead promise a queue and an automatic offer, so the main picture only illustrates a garden and not what Plotwise does.

current.value: Plan titled "Elm Row Gardens, plots 1 to 12" showing only that plots 3 and 8 are empty

findings.target: The plan, or its title, shows the moment of the offer to the next grower in line, in step with the subhead's own claim.
findings.fix_direction: Let the plan show the moment of the offer, or make its title say that plots 3 and 8 are being offered to the next growers in line. Any names, dates or queue positions must come from the maker.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees, in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a plan or plan title that shows plots being offered to the next grower in line, not only which plots are empty.

findings.title: The rent reminder card does not say whose date "March" is

location.description: the description of the third card, Rent reminders

findings.viewer_experience: A reader cannot tell if March is only Elm Row's date or the date every garden uses.

current.value: "Each grower gets one reminder before rent is due in March."

findings.target: The card says whose date March is, or says that each garden sets its own rent date.
findings.fix_direction: If March is only Elm Row's date, say so, or say that each garden sets its own rent date.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic reads the third card in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images and sees that it names whose rent date March is, or that each garden sets its own.

findings.title: Card descriptions on phone and tablet run just under 45 characters per line

location.description: the description of the first card on the phone

findings.viewer_experience: Two-line blurbs at this length read comfortably, so the page is not noticeably harmed.

current.value: 41 to 42 characters per line on the phone, 41 to 44 on the tablet

findings.target: Leave as is unless the card width changes for another reason.
findings.fix_direction: Leave them as they are unless the card width changes for another reason.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of div.cards > div.card > p in the phone and tablet viewports is 45 or more, or the critic accepts the current 41 to 44 as reading comfortably
